span.p:
Relocation (CAP-6 preemption-avoidance and CAP-10 node failure, ARCH AD-8)
moves a workload to an equivalent-or-better node while it stays ACTIVE.
Relocation is NOT a state transition.
QUEUED and PENDING_REVIEW are CAP-1 admission outcomes. The CAP-8 lifecycle
proper is REQUESTED, SCHEDULED, ACTIVE, PREEMPTED, COMPLETED, FAILED.
PREEMPTED, COMPLETED and FAILED are terminal and non-resumable.
